title: NSA certificate for EA280 electronics intelligence course

tellings.quote: this certificate granted to Sherman by the NSA for satisfactory completion of the EA280 intermediate electronics intelligence collection and analysis course.

plain: Michels shows a certificate he says the National Security Agency, the US spy agency for intercepted signals, gave to an Air Force sergeant named Dan Sherman for completing its EA280 intermediate electronics intelligence collection and analysis course. Michels presents the document himself as proof of Sherman's training, in an episode where Sherman says the agency hired him to communicate with aliens.
